description: Compute a point-source air-kerma rate constant from listed NNDC photon lines and NIST air energy-absorption coefficients, with resolved LNHB photon supplements. Apply activity and inverse-square distance with optional line-by-line shielding; collision air kerma (mu_en/rho) is not H*(10), and no broad-beam build-up factor is included. Cs-137 includes equilibrium Ba-137m at 94.7% branching; weak lines and unresolved X-ray groups may be absent.

delta_kev.description: Photon cutoff in keV, strictly greater energies included; default 20.

isotope.description: Nuclide ID, e.g. co60, cs137, ir192.

material.description: Optional shield: lead, concrete, steel approximated by iron, or water.

thickness_mm.description: Optional nonnegative shield thickness in millimetres.

name: gamma_dose_rate
title: Point-source gamma collision air-kerma rate
